subject: Request: Conditional Net-90 + Quarterly Billing for Acme Analytics (DEAL-8421)
messages:
From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <finance@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Net-90 / Quarterly invoicing for pilot

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo — the team at Acme is excited to move forward with a Q4 pilot. A couple of procurement requests came up on our side:

- We'd like to request Net-90 payment terms for the initial quarterly invoice run.
- We also need invoices on a quarterly cadence (one invoice per quarter) to match our internal finance cycles.
- Can Redwood provide a 10% volume discount for the pilot quarter?

I'm attaching the PO and a short note from our finance team. Let me know what information you need to move this through your deal desk / exec approval. We can expedite signatures on our side if you can confirm the terms.

Thanks,
Sara Jensen
Head of Product Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachments: Acme_PO_8421.pdf (PDF, 86KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Net-90 / Quarterly invoicing for pilot

Hi Sara — appreciate the fast turnaround and the PO.

We're supportive of getting the pilot in motion. A quick note on process: Net-90 and a quarterly invoicing cadence are non-standard for initial pilots and will need Deal Desk + Exec sign-off. I've looped in Laura from Sales Ops to start the pricing/contract impacts and to document the request.

To move quickly, could you confirm:
- Expected ARR for the pilot quarter (or projected spend) so we can quantify exposure?
- Will Acme authorize ACH or wire transfers (we can discuss escrow/guarantee options)?

I'll prepare a short internal summary and escalate for conditional approval with suggested safeguards. If you can confirm the finance items by EOD Monday we should be able to get a decision within 48 hours.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0283

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Acme Analytics — Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for pilot (DEAL-8421)

Team — need quick input / exec sign-off on an exceptional payment request. Summary:

- Account: Acme Analytics (prospect → pilot)
- Ask: Net-90 payment terms + quarterly invoicing cadence for initial pilot quarter
- Discount: Customer asked for 10% pilot discount
- Attached: Acme_PO_8421.pdf, draft SOW (SOW_Acme_Q4_pilot.pdf)
- Projected pilot spend: ~$120k licensing + expected variable usage (projected peak token spend up to ~$40k during trial) — Customer confirmed this in call today.

Concerns:
- Net-90 + quarterly invoicing significantly increases receivables exposure (~$160k) and defers cash flow.
- Quarterly invoicing complicates usage reconciliation and may increase billing disputes.

Proposed mitigations for conditional approval (my recommendation):
1) Limit Net-90 to the pilot quarter only; revert to standard Net-30 for renewals.
2) Require an ACH/wire pre-authorization + a signed payment commitment form. If ACH is not possible, require a single upfront interim deposit equal to 50% of projected pilot spend to reduce exposure.
3) Add a revenue-protection clause in the SOW: Redwood may pause service if invoices are >45 days overdue after issue.
4) Approve a one-time pilot discount of 5% (not 10%) contingent on the payment safeguards above.

Request: Rishi / Mina — can you weigh in on acceptability from finance and legal? Jonas — if finance/legal sign off on the mitigations, can we authorize conditional exec approval so Marcus can confirm terms with the customer? Time is tight; customer wants signature this week.

Attachments: SOW_Acme_Q4_pilot.pdf (DOCX, 24KB), Acme_PO_8421.pdf (PDF, 86KB)

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: Acme Analytics — Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for pilot (DEAL-8421)

Marcus / team — thanks for the clear summary and proposed mitigations. After reviewing finance input and legal feedback, I will approve a conditional exception for this pilot with the following firm constraints: 

1) Term & scope: Net-90 applies only to the Q4 pilot invoice(s). Any renewal or expansion reverts to Net-30 by default.
2) Discount: Approve a one-time 5% pilot discount (not to exceed $8k). No recurring discount without separate approval.
3) Payment safeguard: Require ACH mandate + signed payment commitment. If ACH cannot be provided, Acme must deposit 50% of projected pilot spend (min $60k) to Redwood escrow prior to first invoice. Funds may be released against invoices upon payment.
4) Pause clause: Include the revenue-protection clause in SOW — Redwood may suspend or throttle service for invoices >45 days overdue following good-faith notice.
5) Accounting treatment: Finance will record this as a conditional receivable; Rishi, please flag the contract in our ledger and set collections cadence.

Once Marcus confirms acceptance of these constraints with Acme, get the signed payment commitment and we will finalize execution. Laura — please update the contract template to reflect the conditional language and attach the DocuSign link.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
